proposals.mechanism: Initial cast mana is paid only when no active recast. ThunderStep produces projectile plus recast(total2, remaining1, TTL100, targetUUID). Persistent player magic owns active recasts with spell level/source and typed additional payload. Later cast bypasses mana cost, spends remaining count; intermediate spends refresh TTL, last use removes before completion callback. Tick timeout and death also remove via result-aware callback. Login syncs recovered store.
proposals.dedup: Existing8907 SyncedSpellData covers learned/casting/evasion data, not separate PlayerRecasts owner. 0d68 death clone deliberately transfers synced progress/cooldowns, not recasts. 517f5 summoner store owns offline full entity payload rather than a mana-paid future-action count; no extra per summon. 51516 portal world records are shared carrier comparison0. Embers eb3 paid duration alone and generic cooldowns already counted; proposed incremental mechanism is count-limited prepaid casting authority with typed target binding and result-specific consume/expiry callback, not another timer.
limits: ThunderstepProjectile.shouldBeSaved=false while target UUID is persisted. Completion searches current server level and returns if target absent. Durable recast record does not guarantee the target survives reload or cross-dimension moves. Static negative boundary, no runtime reproduction.
PlayerRecasts.loadNBTData does not clear existing map; entries are unchecked compound casts, duplicate IDs overwrite; only positive remaining counts/time accepted, no upper bounds.
RecastInstance casts source with case-sensitive valueOf, cast payload with unchecked CompoundTag; malformed data can abort, unknown spell registry/factory behavior not proven safe.
Optional castData missing on reused RecastInstance does not explicitly clear old data, though actual list loader constructs fresh instances.

MagicData.setServerPlayer replaces recast store when late-binding previously null owner; actual PlayerMagicProvider server read constructs bound store first. Other late-binding paths not asserted lossless.
Online timeout pauses when player offline; result TIMEOUT is not failure for ThunderStep and can complete if target exists. Death and COUNTERSPELL are failure; no permanent Clone whitelist inference.

Mana debit, projectile spawn and recast receipt are sequential, without atomic rollback/addFreshEntity acknowledgement. castSpell posts SpellOnCastEvent and then uses its mana-cost/level values without an observed cancellation check. MagicData.setMana posts a separate ChangeManaEvent; this does not establish that SpellOnCastEvent cancellation prevents payment.
Native attachment engine, mixin application and live game behavior untested; source revision is fixed modern NeoForge and not an API migration patch.
